description: Meet Yatter, where the magic of AI meets the simplicity of everyday conversation. Yatter is your 24/7 chat assistant on WhatsApp, ready to answer your questions & bring a world of knowledge to your fingertips. Explore, learn, & discover with Yatter AI.

name: ZelloDrop
tagline: The 1% platform to sell digital products instantly.
description: Why pay 10%+ in platform fees when you don't have to? ZelloDrop takes just 1% on top of standard card processing. No monthly subscriptions, no complicated setup. Upload your file, name your price, and share one link anywhere you sell. We scan every file for security, generate a unique secure download link, and let you customize checkout with your own branding logo and colors. Full link control and tracking. Simple as that.

name: Zlnk
tagline: Smart Short Links, Endless Possibilities
description: zlnk.com is a smart, feature-rich link management platform. With custom domains, analytics, smart targeting, QR codes, and more, it's the ultimate tool for streamlining sharing, branding, and tracking across all your digital marketing channels

name: Zone
tagline: A liquid glass focus timer for macOS with live dock updates
description: Discover Zone, a sleek macOS timer app designed to enhance your productivity. With its native glass interface and live dock updates, Zone helps you enter deep focus effortlessly. Perfect for anyone looking to improve their focus and time management.

name: Zonké
tagline: Zero config web app deployments to AWS
description: Provision Django, React, Next.js, and NestJS to your AWS development and production environments. Deploy what your product needs, a static landing page, warm serverless functions, or VM/Fargate-backed ECS clusters. Zero infra config, just bring your code.

name: Zoundroom
tagline: App to compose and organize music ideas
description: Zoundroom helps artists capture, organize, and develop their musical ideas — all in one app. Record or import melodies, write lyrics, tag your projects, and get AI-powered creative guidance when inspiration strikes. No more lost voice memos or scattered notes — just a clear space to turn ideas into real songs.
